Talia, the client will keep the automated referral feature operational but will withdraw all referral-related marketing claims within 60 days, without admitting wrongdoing — and this position has not yet been documented in the litigation strategy memo. Evan, your reconciliation is significant: only 312 of the 480 putative class members have arbitration provisions, meaning 168 would remain in the class action regardless. That fundamentally changes our arbitration posture — we cannot seek to compel arbitration for the full class. Here's my assessment: we have two parallel tracks. First, on the arbitration front, we should plan to file a motion to compel arbitration scoped to the 312 users with executed arbitration provisions, while developing a separate litigation strategy for the remaining 168. Second, on the injunctive relief front, the client's position aligns with our proposed limited injunction — keep the referral feature live, withdraw marketing claims within 60 days, no admission of wrongdoing.
